name: An Old History Book
summary: In Stormwind, a lost chronicle returns to the Royal Library. Titled The History of Stormwind, the battered book bears the library’s seal and vanished before the kingdom was rebuilt after the First War. Its return gives Head Librarian Milton Sheaf a chance to preserve the history of southern human lands.

sections.title: A Relic of the First War
sections.body: Duskwood’s undead and ogres roam among the ruins where this mud-caked volume was found. The book is a rare relic from before Stormwind’s destruction. Its opening page bears the kingdom’s formal library seal. Someone checked it out decades ago, before the Horde razed the capital, and the book was presumed lost in the fall of the south.

sections.title: Restoring Forgotten Annals
sections.body: Milton Sheaf recognizes the book when it reaches him in the Royal Library of Stormwind Keep. The head librarian means to place it in the rare books archive, though years in the haunted wilderness have badly damaged its pages. The discovery spurs Sheaf to seek more lost knowledge. He looks north to Southshore, the town nearest the ruined kingdom of Alterac and its abandoned libraries.

aliases: where to find old history book
faq.answer: You find the book among the hostile creatures roaming Duskwood, most often among undead in the cemeteries and fields or ogres in the southern hills.

faq.q: Who do I bring the book to?
aliases: where do i turn this in
faq.answer: Bring the volume to Milton Sheaf, head librarian in the Royal Library inside Stormwind Keep.

faq.q: Why is the book in such poor condition?
faq.answer: The book was checked out before the First War and Stormwind’s sack. It spent decades in Duskwood’s wilderness, exposed to dirt and rot and handled by wandering scavengers and monsters.

faq.q: Does returning this book lead to other tasks?
faq.answer: Yes. Milton Sheaf sends you north to Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills to speak with Loremaster Dibbs, who can direct you to books in the Ruins of Alterac.

faq.q: Why does Milton Sheaf care so much about this specific tome?
faq.answer: Few original records survived when the kingdom was leveled and Stormwind burned during the First War. Genuine pre-war texts help scholars piece together the kingdom’s past.

faq.q: Can Horde players complete this quest?
faq.answer: No. The book belongs to Stormwind’s Royal Library, and only Alliance librarians in Stormwind Keep can accept it.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you help restore fragments of Stormwind’s heritage that survived the First War’s devastation.
As a human of the south, you help reclaim written records from the wilderness and rebuild a culture shattered by the Old Horde.
As a mage, you know ancient libraries hold knowledge that can decay or be neglected when left in the wild.
